name: generic_hyperparameter_ranges_v2
description: Generic Robyn hyperparameter ranges by frequency, adstock type, and channel type for reusable benchmark/test configurations. Extended with a few additional digital channel types to better cover common modern media taxonomies.

presets.conservative: Tighter search space for fast screening and more stable optimization.
presets.exploratory: Wider search space for uncertain channels and stress testing.
presets.fb: Robyn/Facebook official documentation defaults. Channel-type-differentiated theta for geometric adstock: Digital 0.0–0.3, OOH/Print/Radio 0.1–0.4, TV 0.3–0.8 (at weekly frequency, scaled proportionally for daily/monthly). Saturation parameters (alpha, gamma) are uniform across channels.
presets.meshed: Meshed recommended ranges. Channel-type-differentiated for geometric adstock; tighter saturation and higher carryover than Facebook defaults.
